title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates acceleration using a = Δv/Δt, yielding 0.3 m/s².

title: Mass calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates mass using m = F/a, yielding 3000 kg.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Applies F = ma to relate thrust force, mass, and acceleration.

title: Acceleration definition
description: Important: Recognizes acceleration as the rate of change of velocity (Δv/Δt).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (N, m/s, s, kg) throughout calculations.

title: Incorrect force usage
description: Pitfall: Uses impulse-momentum (FΔt = mΔv) incorrectly instead of F = ma for mass.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Treats acceleration or force as negative without justification.
